description: Flat metadata schema for individual patient-derived next-generation sequencing records from rare genetic disorder studies, including clinical context, consent, biospecimen handling, sequencing workflow, and genetic findings.

record_id.descr: Unique identifier for this metadata record within the study or database. Example: RDNGS_000001.

participant_id.descr: Pseudonymized participant identifier used to link clinical, consent, sample, and sequencing data without exposing personal identity.

study_id.descr: Identifier of the study, cohort, or project that generated the record.

site_id.descr: Identifier of the recruiting or sequencing site/institution.

specimen_id.descr: Unique identifier for the biospecimen used for sequencing.

sample_type.descr: Type of biological sample collected. Controlled values may include blood, saliva, buccal swab, tissue, or fibroblast.

biospecimen_source.descr: Anatomical or biological source of the specimen, if applicable. Example: peripheral blood.

collection_date.descr: Date the biospecimen was collected in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD).

age_at_collection_years.descr: Participant age at the time of sample collection, in years.

sex_at_birth.descr: Sex assigned at birth. Example values: female, male, intersex, unknown.

ethnicity.descr: Ethnicity or population affiliation as recorded by the study, using local or standardized categories.

ancestry_notes.descr: Free-text or coded summary of genetic ancestry, if available and ethically collected.

clinical_diagnosis.descr: Primary clinical diagnosis or suspected rare genetic disorder phenotype for which testing was performed.

phenotype_terms.descr: Clinical phenotype terms used to describe the participant, preferably using standardized vocabulary such as HPO terms; may be a comma-separated string if stored flat.

family_history_present.descr: Whether a family history suggestive of inherited disease was reported.

consanguinity_reported.descr: Whether parental consanguinity or relatedness was reported in the family history.

affected_family_members_count.descr: Number of affected relatives reported, if known.

consent_obtained.descr: Whether informed consent was obtained for sample collection and data generation.

consent_type.descr: Type of consent provided, such as broad consent, tiered consent, disease-specific consent, or waiver.

consent_date.descr: Date informed consent was signed or documented in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD).

data_sharing_permission.descr: Whether the participant consented to sharing data with other healthcare institutions or repositories.

data_access_level.descr: Permitted access level for the data, such as open, controlled, restricted, or institution-only.

deidentification_status.descr: Whether the record has been de-identified or pseudonymized prior to analysis or sharing.

dna_extraction_method.descr: Method or kit used to extract DNA from the biospecimen.

dna_extraction_date.descr: Date DNA extraction was performed in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD).

dna_yield_ng.descr: Total extracted DNA yield in nanograms (ng).

dna_concentration_ng_per_ul.descr: DNA concentration in nanograms per microliter (ng/µL).

dna_purity_a260_a280.descr: DNA purity ratio measured by absorbance at 260/280 nm.

dna_integrity_value.descr: DNA integrity metric, if measured. Use the study's reported metric or platform-specific score.

library_prep_method.descr: Library preparation method or kit used prior to sequencing.

target_enrichment_method.descr: Target enrichment strategy, such as whole-genome sequencing, whole-exome sequencing, or gene panel capture.

sequencing_platform.descr: Sequencing instrument/platform used. Example: Illumina NovaSeq, NextSeq, or Oxford Nanopore.

sequencing_chemistry.descr: Sequencing chemistry or read configuration if relevant. Example: paired-end 150 bp.

read_length_bp.descr: Read length in base pairs for a single read.

run_id.descr: Unique identifier for the sequencing run.

flowcell_id.descr: Flowcell or equivalent consumable identifier, if applicable.

sequencing_date.descr: Date sequencing was performed in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD).

mean_coverage_x.descr: Mean sequencing depth across the intended target region, expressed as fold coverage (x).

target_coverage_pct.descr: Percentage of target bases covered at or above the study-defined minimum depth threshold.

duplication_rate.descr: Fraction or percentage of duplicate reads identified during processing; store as the study's chosen numeric representation.

mapping_rate.descr: Percentage of reads successfully aligned to the reference genome.

reference_genome_build.descr: Reference genome assembly used for alignment and variant calling. Example: GRCh37/hg19 or GRCh38/hg38.

variant_calling_pipeline.descr: Variant calling workflow or software package used to identify sequence variants.

annotation_tool.descr: Tool or database pipeline used for variant annotation.

variant_filtering_criteria.descr: Summary of the variant filtering thresholds or rules applied. Example: quality score, depth, allele fraction, inheritance model.

pathogenic_variant_present.descr: Whether at least one variant was classified as pathogenic or likely pathogenic.

variant_count_total.descr: Total number of variants reported for the record after filtering or annotation, if applicable.

variant_gene_symbol.descr: Gene symbol associated with the main reported variant or primary finding.

variant_hgvs_c.descr: HGVS coding DNA nomenclature for the primary variant.

variant_hgvs_p.descr: HGVS protein nomenclature for the primary variant, if applicable.

variant_consequence.descr: Predicted molecular consequence of the main variant, such as missense, nonsense, frameshift, splice-site, or synonymous.

variant_classification.descr: Clinical classification of the variant, such as pathogenic, likely pathogenic, uncertain significance, likely benign, or benign.

zygosity.descr: Zygosity state of the reported variant. Example: heterozygous, homozygous, hemizygous, mosaic.

inheritance_pattern.descr: Observed or inferred inheritance pattern. Example: de novo, autosomal dominant, autosomal recessive, X-linked, compound heterozygous.

clinical_interpretation.descr: Brief clinical interpretation of the sequencing result, such as diagnostic, inconclusive, negative, or incidental finding.

diagnostic_yield.descr: Whether sequencing resulted in a molecular diagnosis for the participant.

report_date.descr: Date the final genetic report or interpretation was issued in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD).

reporting_clinician_role.descr: Role of the professional who reviewed or signed out the report, such as clinical geneticist, molecular pathologist, or genetic counselor.

reanalysis_performed.descr: Whether the data were later reanalyzed using updated pipelines or knowledge bases.

reanalysis_date.descr: Date of reanalysis, if performed, in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD).

data_repository_accession.descr: External repository accession or DOI where the record or associated data are deposited, if available.

data_use_criteria.descr: Restrictions or permitted uses for the data, such as disease-specific research only, non-commercial use, or controlled-access conditions.
